summary: Iteration 220 — (A) multi-source lead discovery (routes/lead_discover.py), (B) Mira brain memory injection (services/mira_brain.py + routes/mira_hq.py), and (C) Signup top switcher + timezone-based auto-redirect + region hint. Backend: 7 pytest tests on /app/backend/tests/test_iter220_discover_brain.py — 6 passed + 1 skipped. Passed: GET /api/super-admin/mira-leads/discover/sources returns exactly {instagram,facebook,linkedin,web,email}; unauthed → 403; discover 422 for 1-char city; discover unauthed → 401/403; GET /api/super-admin/mira/memory returns ≥1 auto-source rows (2 'discovery' auto rows in mongo); POST /api/super-admin/mira/ask responds with a non-empty answer that references outreach stats (brain_prompt injection works). The dedupe test (POST discover Pune/facebook twice) was SKIPPED on this rerun because DuckDuckGo+Bing returned 0 raw hits (rate-limited from the preview IP) and the endpoint correctly returns {found:0,saved:0,note:'…'} with no run_id. The initial clean run of the same test (earlier full suite) returned a run_id, saved leads, and the second call deduped (saved <= first) — confirmed working, cleanup fixture then deleted all Pune mira_discover leads and run docs. Frontend (super-admin + 2 incognito contexts for timezone): /signup-salon with Asia/Kolkata → /signup-salon-india; with America/New_York → /signup-salon-us; same for /signup-restaurant → /signup-restaurant-{us|india}. On /signup-restaurant-india: [data-testid=signup-switch-links] is ABOVE [data-testid=signup-form-card] (y=120 < y=174), contains exactly 4 links, [data-testid=signup-switch-restaurant-in] has aria-current='page'; href on signup-switch-salon-us = /signup-salon-us; zero occurrences of 'Wrong page' text. Region hint: with US tz on /signup-salon-india the hint renders text containing 'outside India' and '$ US / International pricing', [data-testid=signup-region-hint-switch] href=/signup-salon-us; clicking [data-testid=signup-region-hint-dismiss] hides it; after reload (sessionStorage) it stays hidden; with Asia/Kolkata on /signup-salon-india no hint renders (count=0). HQ Mira Lead Agent → Find & review leads: [data-testid=lead-discover-panel] visible, exactly 5 [data-testid=discover-source-*] chips (instagram/facebook/linkedin/web/email), all aria-pressed='true' by default; clicking a chip toggles aria-pressed to 'false'; [data-testid=discover-run-btn] text in salon mode = 'Find salons everywhere ✦', after toggling [data-testid=lead-vertical-restaurant] it becomes 'Find restaurants everywhere ✦'. Per task instructions the run button was NOT clicked a 3rd time (budget already spent on backend pytest). Regression: [data-testid=wa-blast-open-btn] opens the WA Blast modal; [data-testid=super-sidebar] renders; [data-testid=hq-page-title]='Mira Lead Agent'. Overall: all task checks for Mira brain, multi-source discovery and signup redesign work as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: lead_discover.py line 93-94 early-return path (empty raw) does NOT include a run_id, while the normal path (line 128) does. The frontend only reads data.saved and data.note so it's fine, but any API consumer relying on run_id would need to handle the key being absent. Consider always returning run_id (even for a 0-result run) and still inserting a mira_lead_runs doc so operators can see search-engine throttling in history.

lead_discover.py — DuckDuckGo + Bing scraping is unauth'd and visibly rate-limited from the preview IP; discovery intermittently returns 0 raw hits. Not a bug but suggests adding a server-side cache or a 3rd fallback (SerpAPI/Brave) to make the feature reliable in production.

SignupSalon.jsx — the timezone-based redirect runs inside useState initializer and calls window.location.replace during render. Works, but is a known React anti-pattern (side effects in init). Consider moving to a top-level useEffect with an early-return guard component.
SignupSalon.jsx line 50 — sessionStorage access in useState init can throw in private-mode browsers that disable storage; wrap in try/catch like the other storage reads in this file.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6 passed / 1 skipped — skip is upstream rate-limit tolerance; dedupe path verified on earlier full run)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Discovery endpoint hits DDG+Bing which are rate-limited from this IP — expect intermittent {found:0,saved:0,note:...} 200 responses. Backend test skips the dedupe assertion gracefully in that case. Call POST /api/super-admin/mira-leads/discover sparingly (LLM + web). To exercise lead-found-on-{id} badges in UI you need at least one lead with discovered_by='mira_discover' in mongo (none exist currently after cleanup).
